title: calendar sync request
description: Explicit confirm. Idempotency-Key required. provider is fixed to mock while PO-6 is open; a real provider needs a new calendar.v1 contract. itemRevisions is a JSON object keyed by itemId with the revision the student reviewed, so duplicate ids cannot be expressed and the written revision equals the reviewed one (per-item precondition_failed otherwise). Every id must belong to the path syllabus and owner.
